implementation: DispatchFlow performs all local multipart and endpoint validation before creating an uncertain chain.

DispatchCommit.Begin uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE to atomically persist SubmitIntent STARTED, PlacementAttempt ADD_SENT/STARTED/POSSIBLE_EFFECT, RaceJob ADD_SENT and a dispatch-start event before Sender.Send can run.
DispatchWorker accepts only facts modeling an already durable ADD_SENT/STARTED/POSSIBLE_EFFECT marker and consumes each Attempt at most once in-process.
DispatchCommit.Record atomically records response_fact_at and advances accepted responses to AWAITING_CONFIRMATION or ambiguous responses to UNKNOWN.

A known-not-sent result closes the current Attempt and Job as ADD_FAILED/FAILED_NO_EFFECT; it never rewinds the same Attempt to NOT_STARTED and safe retry requires the existing two-phase requeue path with a new Attempt.
Startup recovery atomically promotes an interrupted ADD_SENT chain to UNKNOWN, keeps or restores its waiter and never exposes it as an automatic redispatch candidate.
Application startup executes deterministic recovery before exposing HTTP traffic and fails closed on chain invariant violations.
Production dispatch remains disabled by default and cannot be enabled while a probed qB Profile is EXPECTED.

before_body_send: Malformed Add input is rejected before DispatchCommit.Begin and leaves RESERVED/NOT_STARTED unchanged.
Cancellation before Sender.Send is persisted as ADD_FAILED/FAILED_NO_EFFECT without invoking the sender.
after_body_send_before_response_commit: The sender callback observes ADD_SENT/STARTED/POSSIBLE_EFFECT and dispatch_started_at before any network side effect.
A simulated kill after one successful send but before DispatchCommit.Record is recovered as UNKNOWN; a subsequent Run is rejected and sender_calls remains one.
after_response_commit: DispatchCommit.Record replay is idempotent and does not duplicate result events.
DispatchCommit.Begin rejects every replay once dispatch_state has reached STARTED.
